text:
maya: hey folks — quick ask: 2-hour movie or a 10-song album for plane travel? leaning toward something offbeat/visually cool, not MCU-sized 

devin: if you want visuals + mood, watch The Fall (Tarsem). feels like traveling through a photo album. also great score. :camera_flash:

samir: for albums, try Max Richter — The Blue Notebooks. very airplane-friendly, kind of meditative. puts me to sleep in 10 tracks.

elaine: adding to this: if you want something melancholy but beautiful, 'A Ghost Story' (movie) is subtle and weird. not actiony.

maya: oooh thanks — anyone got truly obscure scores? like not just well-known composers but hidden gems?

jordan: check out 'Akram Khan & Nitin Sawhney' stuff, but also look up 'Ryuichi Sakamoto — async' if you want minimal/experimental.

samir: random rec: 'The Proposition' score by Nick Cave & Warren Ellis. gritty and oddly haunting.

devin: on the documentary front — warning: very sad but brilliant: Dear Zachary. carry tissues. heartwrecking.

maya: noted. (adds tissues emoji) any recommendations for something to balance that sadness on the flight? upbeat album recs?

elaine: for upbeat but not poppy: Jungle (self-titled) — funky, good rhythms. or Khruangbin for chill grooves.

bot-music: auto-playlist suggestion: "Redwood Offbeat Flights" — small sampler: Max Richter - On the Nature of Daylight / Nick Cave - The Proposition Theme / Khruangbin - Friday Morning / Ryuichi Sakamoto - async excerpt / Jungle - Busy Earnin'. https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-link-123 (placeholder) :headphones:

jordan: real talk: Dear Zachary wrecked me for a week. but if you want a sad doc that ultimately feels Important, it's a must-watch.

maya: ok this is a great pile of recs. will pick one movie + one album. thanks y'all :raised_hands: 

samir: quick poll: movie or album for the in-flight headphone-only vibe? :airplane: :musical_note:

devin: album (works better for sleeping on planes)

elaine: movie (but bring noise-cancelling headphones)

bot-music: poll results (informal): album 2 — movie 2 — undecided 2 :thinking_face:

maya: tie-breaker by coin flip: album it is. will report back with whether I cried or just slept. :coin:

jordan: curious which tracks you end up loving. might steal them.

maya: will share a photo of the in-flight playlist screenshot and a tiny review. promise not to add spoilers for Dear Zachary if I watch it later :)
